decisions.reason: The cross-Requirement effect is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, including the 44Ω series-resistor purpose and optional installation policy; no edit is required.
Optional SDA/SCL series resistors do not change the standalone USB power source, activation condition, LDO capacity, or powered scope.
The source concerns I2C SDA/SCL signal conditioning, not addressable-LED supply voltage, switching, or data-level shifting.
The I2C series-resistor policy does not alter the main-board power sources, OR-ing method, diode selection, or source-selection behavior.
The source changes only the population policy and purpose of series resistors on SDA/SCL; it does not assign or reassign any GPIO.
The referenced 44Ω SDA/SCL series resistors are unrelated to the CHGLED circuit, R6, D1 population, or battery-charge indication.
Although the interboard signal connector carries SDA0 and SCL0, the source does not change its connector type, pinout, physical numbering, or matching-order requirement.
The source concerns main-board I2C signal conditioning and does not affect the battery connector, pin functions, placement, voltage range, or AXP2101 connection.
The optional I2C series resistors do not change the switched 5V boost rail, its enable GPIO, pull-down, current rating, or powered loads.
The source does not concern the AXP2101 VMID/VSYS topology or its net labeling.
The SDA/SCL series-resistor decision does not affect the power-board USB-C connector or its sourceability requirements.
The source does not change the LED board's addressable LED type or count.
